(2) A young man in a black t-shirt and khaki shorts sits on a beige sofa, reacting with surprise as a woman in a grey tank top and shorts jumps into the frame with her arms raised high, screaming. The room is decorated in a modern, minimalist style. (3) The scene shifts to the man, now shirtless and wearing bright pink shorts, squatting by a bird cage and a kitchen utility cart. The woman crawls silently behind him before suddenly standing up and yelling. He jumps in fright, throwing his arms up. (4) The woman is then seen sitting on the sofa holding an acoustic guitar. She demonstrates a survival tactic by lifting the guitar high above her head while shouting. The man is visible in the background, laughing and observing her performance. (5) In the final sequence, the man enters through a glass door from a balcony, carrying a plastic bag filled with food. The woman, still on the sofa with the guitar, laughs as she watches him. The apartment layout includes a television and a kitchen area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a clean female voice narration from a phone video at a moderate volume. The speech rate is calm and steady. Background room tone is minimal. (2) A sharp transition follows with a very loud, high-intensity female scream, which peaks the signal significantly. This is immediately followed by a male's startled exclamation and genuine, high-energy laughter. (3) Conversational dialogue between the two speakers ensues, characterized by moderate conversational loudness and clear articulation. The tone is cheerful and informal. (4) Another explosive female scream triggers a new phase, accompanied by the sounds of fabric rustling as the man jumps. A bird in the background adds high-pitched chirping sounds to the mix. (5) The final phase features the sound of a glass door opening with a mechanical slide and click, followed by rhythmic footsteps on a tiled floor. The male voice returns with a high-valence, energetic tone announcing the arrival of food.
